title: 摩根士丹利邢自强：5%目标靠基建和出口，能持续吗
speaker: Robin Xing

segments.en: What is that going to mean for your GDP growth outlook for this year?
segments.zh: 这对你今年的GDP增长预期意味着什么？

segments.en: Is that a way that China can avoid the moderation from last year's 5% growth?
segments.zh: 这是否能让中国避免从去年5%的增长放缓？

segments.en: Well, the government has kind of lowered its own target in a pragmatic way, right?
segments.zh: 政府务实地下调了目标，对吧？

segments.en: I do think with certain acceleration of the bond and the quota fiscal tools to catch up on the infrastructure building in the second half.
segments.zh: 我认为下半年加快债券和额度财政工具，以赶上基建建设。

segments.en: We may see some bonds back, and the annual target is still within reach, but that largely rely on infrastructure and global trade.
segments.zh: 我们可能会看到一些债券回归，年度目标仍可实现，但这主要依赖基建和全球贸易。

segments.en: China benefited from the global super cycle on AI infrastructure and energy spending, so their exports has been booming.
segments.zh: 中国受益于AI基础设施和能源支出的全球超级周期，出口一直繁荣。

segments.en: We do think the resilience of Chinese exports is the bright spot. It will continue to march on.
segments.zh: 我们认为中国出口的韧性是亮点，将继续前进。
